whatItDoes.text: Nike designs, develops, markets and sells athletic footwear, apparel, equipment, accessories and services worldwide.
whatItDoes.quote: Our principal business activity is the design, development and worldwide marketing and selling of athletic footwear, apparel, equipment, accessories and services.

howItMakesMoney.text: NIKE Brand wholesale generated $27.5 billion in fiscal 2026.
howItMakesMoney.quote: NIKE Brand wholesale revenues were $27.5 billion in fiscal 2026 compared to $25.9 billion in fiscal 2025.

source.label: 10-K filed July 15, 2026 · Item 7, Management's Discussion and Analysis

howItMakesMoney.text: NIKE Direct generated $17.7 billion in fiscal 2026.
howItMakesMoney.quote: NIKE Direct revenues were $17.7 billion in fiscal 2026 compared to $18.8 billion in fiscal 2025, primarily driven by a decrease in traffic.

source.label: 10-K filed July 15, 2026 · Item 7, Management's Discussion and Analysis

competitiveEdge.text: Nike says it competes on product quality, innovation, performance and design.
competitiveEdge.quote: Product attributes such as quality; innovation and development; performance and reliability; new product style and design; as well as consumer price/value.

competitiveEdge.text: Nike believes it is competitive in all areas.
competitiveEdge.quote: We believe that we are competitive in all of these areas.

marketPosition.text: Nike states it is the largest seller of athletic footwear and apparel worldwide.
marketPosition.quote: NIKE is the largest seller of athletic footwear and apparel in the world.

biggestRisks.text: Sales depend on discretionary consumer spending.
biggestRisks.quote: Our sales are impacted by discretionary spending by consumers.

biggestRisks.text: The company may be unable to obtain financing at reasonable rates.
biggestRisks.quote: we may be unable to access financing in the credit and capital markets at reasonable rates

biggestRisks.text: Currency fluctuations create exposure to exchange‑rate risk.
biggestRisks.quote: We transact in various currencies, which creates exposure to fluctuations in foreign currency exchange rates

outlook.text: Nike expects negative impacts from Greater China and Converse to continue through fiscal 2027.
outlook.quote: We expect negative impacts from Greater China and Converse to continue throughout fiscal 2027.

source.label: 10-K filed July 15, 2026 · Item 7, Management's Discussion and Analysis

upcoming.text: Nike plans to reorganize into three geographies in fiscal 2028.
upcoming.quote: NIKE plans to organize into three geographies in fiscal 2028

source.label: 10-Q filed October 2, 2026 · Part I Item 2, Management's Discussion and Analysis

dropped.text: The company notes the industry is highly competitive worldwide.
dropped.quote: The athletic footwear, apparel and equipment industry is highly competitive on a worldwide basis.

dropped.text: Demand is driven by the popularity of sports, fitness activities, design trends and consumer preferences.
dropped.quote: the relative popularity and availability of various sports and fitness activities, as well as changing design trends and consumer preferences, affect the demand for our products.

dropped.text: Management believes the actions will reignite brand momentum and drive long‑term shareholder value.
dropped.quote: We believe these actions will reignite brand momentum and reposition our business to drive long-term shareholder value.
